title: Academic tone
description: Write with impersonal style, nominalisation, and analytical distance.

introduction.headline: Write with academic precision
introduction.body: Use nominalisation and impersonal constructions to create analytical distance and emphasise ideas over personality.
introduction.bodyIt: Usa nominalizzazione e costruzioni impersonali per creare distanza analitica ed enfatizzare le idee rispetto alla personalità.

vocabulary.example: Academic tone avoids slang and exaggeration.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Il tono accademico evita slang ed esagerazioni.

vocabulary.example: The analysis focuses on long-term outcomes.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: L'analisi si concentra sugli esiti a lungo termine.

vocabulary.example: Academic writing emphasises evidence and logic.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: La scrittura accademica enfatizza prove e logica.

options: how people do the policy thing
exercises.explanation: Nominalisation is typical of academic style.

exercises.explanation: Distance and analysis define academic register.

review.tip: Rewrite one personal sentence using a nominalisation.
